With past brands I've told my friends at the gym, "I'm using hippy deodorant today so if I smell like Pig Pen- that's why." They all smelled bad, or did not smell at all, but mainly - did nothing. I could smell sweat even if using them 5 mins earlier. reviews.t: Best non-aluminum roll on deodurant I've tried
reviews.x: I love that this is a liquid roll on non-aluminum deodorant! It keeps me mostly dry, but more importantly  it keeps the stink down!!! Very hard to find with non-aluminum deodorants as they are not anti-perspirant. I somtimes have to reapply mid day to maintain a fresh smell. On another note, I tried the Native deodurant that the internet seems to love but I was so much stinkier throughout the day with that. Nivea works a lot better for me and I will be buying again.

This is a great product especially if you are concerned about your health. reviews.t: My quest appears to be over, FINALLY a treasure, after 20+ years of trying non-aluminum deodorants!
reviews.x: Howdy intrepid aluminum-free deodorant researchers and adventurers!  I've spent hundreds of dollars over 20+ years buying Schmidts, Native, Tom's, Lume, Kopari, Lavanila, the natural salt crystals, making my own using a schmear of coconut oil and then patting some baking soda on top of it, and some men's Deos like Old Spice, hoping to find something that works for me. reviews.t: Lovely long lasting fragrance! And carcinogen free!!
reviews.x: I first bought this deodorant when I was traveling in Germany and forgot my normal deodorant at home - I've never looked back! It's aluminum free so it won't prevent sweat, but it has a lovely unobtrusive fragrance that will last all day! I guess I wouldn't recommend it for anyone with a problem with perspiration. My only complaint is that its so difficult to find, even on amazon :( Nivea please expand more products to the US market or create a bulk order option!!

reviews.t: What a find!!!! Works as well as antiperspirant without a strong smell!!
reviews.x: This is seriously the millionth non-aluminum deoderant that I've tried, all of them failing and falling short of working... until now! I realize that everyone's body chemistry is different, but the smell of this is not over powering, as some non-antiperspirants can be, and it still actually WORKS!!! Maybe even a BETTER! reviews.t: 0% aluminum-free blend from Germany -- the best formula!!
reviews.x: This is the best 0% aluminum-free deodorant. The German blend (Beiersdorf - Hamburg. Wien) is better than the Nivea produced and imported from Mexico. I'm not sure why their (Nivea) manufacturing formulas are not consistent. But, I purchased this during travel and it is fabulous, especially if you are looking for a healthy personal care selection. My favorite! Totally recommend it and wish it was a staple in our US stores!!
It smells nice but what a joke mail it in an envelope when it's a glass container.

reviews.t: This one has a nice fresh scent and it works all day
reviews.x: This Deoderant is aluminum free, and it actually works! Most "natural" deodorants only work for me for a short period, and with any exercise or strenuous activity I smell musty. This one has a nice fresh scent and it works all day.

That was until I came across someone giving a review on another brand of deodorant, and they just happened to mention (and with much praise) this particular Nivea deodorant, so I just had to check it out. reviews.x: Well the smell is nice but it makes me stink worse than not wearing any at all. It lasts like 10 minutes and then I smell really bad. Also I was quite irritated when I received the package the bottle itself was wrapped in multiple stickers with bar codes on them. They covered the actual lable of the product and the adhesive on the stickers was so strong I couldn't get them off and it was very gooey. So I had stick hands everytine I used it! Not happy with it at.all.

I have ordered this from Germany for 18 years. I work in construction. Every once in a while (month? two months?), it seems to stop working, then I use a normal Stick ONCE (with aluminium, a standard US brand, NOT CLINICAL) and I'm back to normal for another couple of months.  Note that this is NOT an anti-perspirant. Underarm perspiration gets rid of many toxins. Ask yourself this: if you block the toxins in, where do they go and how do they get there?

It works, but the white stuff gets on your clothes and makes a mess. This one does not last 48hrs for sure, however, it does last until I start sweating on my workout. reviews.t: This is my favorite deodorant without aluminum
reviews.x: This is my favorite deodorant without aluminum. I have tried many. It smells fresh and light - I generally buy unscented everything so finding a deodorant without an overpowering scent was important to me.  It does a decent job of masking smell on normal days. I reapply on 100 degree days.

I've tried other versions of this nivea aluminum free deodorant but this one seemed like a dud. Smelled ok but never seemed to be able to mask sweat odor for more than like an hour or two. Definitely not a good product for hot summer months.

Love this deodorant!  I have been looking for deodorant without the aluminum for a few years and nothing works.  This works and smells great!  Will continue to purchase from this seller as well.  They care about their products.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say this deodorant actually works, unlike many other aluminum-free deodorants they have tried.
Many reviewers describe having tried dozens of other natural/aluminum-free deodorants before finding this one.
Reviewers praise the scent as pleasant, fresh, and long-lasting.
Some reviewers note it is not an antiperspirant and may require reapplication or won't stop sweat.
A few reviewers complain about packaging/shipping problems, including a glass bottle mailed in an envelope and a 'free sample' tag.
